ex.en: The coach watched the young players like a hawk during the whole match.
ex.zh: 整场比赛中，教练像鹰一样紧盯着年轻球员。

words.note: hawk 作动词指沿街叫卖；watch sb like a hawk 表严密监视。

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while running down the stairs this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上她跑下楼梯时扭伤了脚踝。

words.note: twist one's ankle 指崴脚；twist 也可指转折。

ex.en: The minister was not forthcoming about his plans for the coming year.
ex.zh: 部长不愿透露他来年的计划。

words.note: forthcoming 除「即将到来」，还指人「乐于提供信息」，多用于否定句。

ex.en: The old soldiers sang patriotic songs at the memorial ceremony.
ex.zh: 老兵们在纪念仪式上唱起了爱国歌曲。

words.note: patriot 是爱国者，-ic 构成形容词，patriotism 指爱国主义。

ex.en: The surgery went well, but the patient later developed a serious complication.
ex.zh: 手术很顺利，但病人后来出现了严重的并发症。

words.note: complication 医学上指「并发症」；动词是 complicate。

ex.en: The students were perplexed by the question and asked for a hint.
ex.zh: 学生们被这道题难住了，请求给点提示。

words.note: perplex 与 confuse 近义，常用 be perplexed by。

ex.en: The government has promised to spend more money on combating pollution.
ex.zh: 政府承诺投入更多资金治理污染。

words.note: combat 作动词重音在后 /kəmˈbæt/，作名词重音在前；常表示与不良事物斗争。

ex.en: She despised him for lying to his own parents.
ex.zh: 她因他对自己的父母撒谎而看不起他。

words.note: despise 语气强，指轻蔑地看不起，与 hate 的单纯厌恶略有不同。

ex.en: The city plans to levy a tax on empty houses.
ex.zh: 这座城市计划对空置房屋征税。

words.note: levy a tax on 是固定搭配；levy 作名词时指征收的税款。

ex.en: He rarely indulges in expensive meals, even on his birthday.
ex.zh: 即使在生日，他也难得吃顿昂贵的大餐。

words.note: indulge in 接名词或动名词；indulge a child 指纵容孩子。

ex.en: The witness said she had been intimidated into keeping silent.
ex.zh: 证人说她受到恐吓而保持沉默。

words.note: intimidate sb into doing 是常用结构；强调以威胁使人害怕而屈从。

ex.en: The new drug proved highly effective against the virus.
ex.zh: 这种新药被证明对这种病毒非常有效。

words.note: effective 指有效果，efficient 指效率高，两者常被混用，注意区分。

ex.en: The crisis brought a sense of unity to the small community.
ex.zh: 这场危机让这个小社区产生了团结感。

words.note: unit 是单位，unite 是联合，unity 指团结统一的状态。

ex.en: She moved to another city to pursue a career in design.
ex.zh: 她搬到另一座城市去从事设计工作。

words.note: pursue 常接 career、dream；名词是 pursuit。

ex.en: He told a vulgar joke that made everyone at the table uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他讲了个粗俗的笑话，让在座的人都不自在。

words.note: vulgar 指言语举止粗俗下流；口语中 cheap 有相近义，但语气较轻。

ex.en: The flood was the worst catastrophe the region had seen in decades.
ex.zh: 这场洪水是该地区几十年来最严重的灾难。

words.note: cata- 表「向下」，strophe 表「转」，原指剧情突转，现指大灾难。

ex.en: Words alone cannot convey how grateful I am for your help.
ex.zh: 单靠言语无法表达我对你帮助的感激。

words.note: convey 可指传递信息、表达感情或运送，比 tell 更书面。

ex.en: The course is designed to help students write clear reports.
ex.zh: 这门课旨在帮助学生写出清楚的报告。

words.note: by design 意为故意，反义是 by accident。

ex.en: He is generous with his time and often helps younger colleagues.
ex.zh: 他很舍得花时间，经常帮助年轻同事。

words.note: generous with 指在某方面大方；generous to sb 指对某人慷慨。

ex.en: By coincidence, we booked seats on the same flight.
ex.zh: 碰巧我们订了同一班飞机的座位。

words.note: by coincidence 是固定短语；动词 coincide 指同时发生或相一致。

ex.en: Many small shops fell victim to the sudden rise in rent.
ex.zh: 许多小店成了租金暴涨的受害者。

words.note: fall victim to 中不加冠词；victim 常与 of 连用。

ex.en: The airline went bust after the sudden drop in passengers.
ex.zh: 客流量骤降后，这家航空公司破产了。

words.note: go bust 是口语说法，指生意破产；bust 也指半身像或警方的突击搜查。

ex.en: He fell from the ladder and suffered a fractured skull.
ex.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来，颅骨骨折。

words.note: skull 指整个头骨，brain 是大脑；fractured skull 是常见搭配。

ex.en: She became hysterical when she heard the news of the accident.
ex.zh: 听到事故的消息，她变得歇斯底里。

words.note: hysterical 形容情绪失控；hysterical laughter 指狂笑。

ex.en: The driver changed lanes without signalling and nearly caused a crash.
ex.zh: 那名司机没打灯就变道，差点造成撞车。

words.note: lane 指车道或乡间小路；change lanes 是变道，注意用复数。

ex.en: The river was contaminated with waste from the nearby factory.
ex.zh: 这条河被附近工厂的废料污染了。

words.note: contaminate 强调有害物混入水源、食物等；名词是 contamination。

ex.en: The soldiers were running low on ammunition after two days of fighting.
ex.zh: 打了两天，士兵们的弹药快用完了。

words.note: ammunition 不可数；give sb ammunition 指给对方把柄。

ex.en: The chief reason for his failure was a lack of preparation.
ex.zh: 他失败的主要原因是准备不足。

words.note: chief 作形容词只作定语；也可作名词指首领。

ex.en: Her account is in accord with what the other witnesses said.
ex.zh: 她的说法与其他证人的说法一致。

words.note: of one's own accord 意为自愿；in accord with 表一致。

ex.en: She is one of the country's foremost experts on climate change.
ex.zh: 她是该国最著名的气候变化专家之一。

words.note: first and foremost 意为首要的是；只作定语。
